keyFindings.text: API importer preserves databases → Bases; HTML loses all DB structure
Bases has no native relations/rollups — Notion Bases plugin or Dataview needed
mcp-notion exposes 24 tools across 6 domains; 5 API gaps require direct API calls
mcp-obsidian operates at file layer via notesmd-cli (headless) + MCP (live app, 14 tools)
In-app Importer cannot be AI-driven; agent works around it via file-layer operations
Notion Bases plugin (bgarciamoura/obsidian-notion-bases-plugin) is P0 required for relations/rollups/formulas/extra views
Three-way plugin recovery matrix: Notion Bases > Dataview > .base files for every relation/rollup/formula pattern
Comment migration is not supported by the importer; reconstruction via callout blocks is the AI agent's task
API 2.0 data-source model requires database→data_source_id bridging during inventory
Notion page hierarchy is preserved by the API importer as folder nesting; ordering and breadcrumbs are lost
Hybrid migration flow: human does 3 GUI actions (create integration, install plugins, run Import), AI does everything else
Large workspace (5000 pages, 50 DBs) requires ~64 min API time at 3 req/s for full deep inventory
Two-pass verification: AI automated script (page count, link validation, attachment presence, row count, frontmatter check) + human sample (5% page quality, 10 critical formulas)
Relation reconstruction is the highest-value AI task — rewriting UUIDs to [[wikilinks]] across hundreds of notes saves hours vs manual
Notion-specific formula functions (prop(), name(), style(), unstyle()) have no direct Obsidian equivalent and require manual translation

ruledOutDirections.reason: Loses all database views, properties, formulas, relations, rollups
Omits important data per official Obsidian docs
.base files (core Bases) support only 6 column types — no relations, rollups, formulas
Dataview has TABLE/LIST/CALENDAR but no Board/Gantt/Chart/Gallery views

ruledOutDirections.approach: Full autonomous AI migration without human GUI actions
